s1 = winsorize(ts_backfill({special_items_score}, 63), std=4)
s2 = winsorize(ts_backfill({accrued_expenses_score}, 63), std=4)
s3 = winsorize(ts_backfill({revenue_recognition_score}, 63), std=4)
s4 = winsorize(ts_backfill({deferred_rev_score}, 63), std=4)
avg_score = divide(add(add(add(s1, s2), s3), s4), 4)
ind_z = group_zscore(avg_score, industry)
bottom_tail = less(ind_z, -1.5)
top_tail = greater(ind_z, 1.8)
core = if_else(bottom_tail, multiply(2.0, ind_z), if_else(top_tail, multiply(-0.8, ind_z), multiply(0.3, ind_z)))
signal = core
idea: 行业相对极端风险分层：在行业内标准化后，使用逻辑运算符切分下尾（低分，高操纵风险）和上尾（高分，潜在的"过度完美" deception 风险）。对极端低分赋予强负向权重，对极端高分赋予 mild 负向权重（防范虚增），中段给予温和正向权重，实现非线性的分段风险定价。
